info.title: NyayaSetu - Court Case Scheduling & Hearing Management System
info.description: Backend REST API and Judicial Services for Court Case Scheduling and Hearing Management System

post.description:
Authenticate user with username or email and password.
Records successful and unsuccessful login attempts in the audit log (FR-4.1.3).
Standard OAuth2 password flow endpoint enabling direct authorization in Swagger docs (/docs).

get.description: View currently authenticated user's profile and role-specific judicial details.

post.description: Terminate active session and log logout in audit trail (FR-4.1.3).
Initiate password reset via registered email (FR-4.1.3).
Complete password reset with new secure password.
Administrator onboards a new judicial user and assigns role (FR-4.1.3 Authentication.Role.Assign).

get.summary: List Users with Optional Role Filter
get.description: List registered judicial users. Accessible to Admins and Court Clerks.

schema.title: Response List Users Api V1 Users Get

put.description: Administrator activates or deactivates user accounts (FR-4.1.3 Authentication.Account.Status).

get.description: Helper endpoint returning list of active judges and their availability for scheduling.

post.description: Checks for potential duplicate registrations before filing (FR-4.2.3 Case.Duplicate.Check).
Registers a new judicial case, generates unique Case ID, and records initial history (FR-4.2.3).

get.description: Multi-criteria case search and filter with role-based scoping (FR-4.2.3 Case.Search).

parameters.name: q

schema.description: Search term for case number, title, or party
schema.title: Q

parameters.description: Search term for case number, title, or party

schema.title: Response Search Cases Api V1 Cases Get

get.summary: Get Case Details with Documents and History
get.description: Returns complete case dossier, including attached documents, evidence, and historical timeline.

put.description: Updates the judicial case lifecycle state (Registered -> Active -> Pending -> Disposed).

post.description: Assigns an authorized lawyer to represent a party in the case.
Uploads a legal document with SHA-256 integrity validation and automatic version control (FR-4.5.3).

get.description: Secure download with role-based access validation (FR-4.5.3 Documents.Download).

post.description: Uploads digital evidence with SHA-256 cryptographic verification (FR-4.5.3 Documents.Evidence.Attach).

get.description: Returns full chronological judicial history and audit trail of the case (FR-4.7.3 Tracking.Timeline).

schema.title: Response Get Case History Api V1 Cases  Case Id  History Get

post.description:
AI-Powered hearing scheduling recommendation engine (FR-4.3.3 Scheduling.AI.Recommend).
Optimizes for judge specialization, courtroom availability, case priority, and workload balance.
Detects scheduling conflicts for judge, courtroom, advocate, and court calendar (FR-4.3.3 Scheduling.Conflict.Detect).

Schedules a new court hearing (FR-4.3.3 Scheduling.Create).
Verifies conflict avoidance and records judicial resource allocations.

get.description: List hearings with flexible date, judge, courtroom, and status filtering.

schema.title: Response List Hearings Api V1 Hearings Get

get.description: Returns single hearing proceeding record.

put.description: Reschedules an existing hearing to a new date, time, judge, or courtroom (FR-4.3.3 Scheduling.Reschedule).
Cancels a scheduled hearing and releases judicial resources (FR-4.3.3 Scheduling.Cancel).
Adjourns hearing and records reason and next target date (FR-4.7.3 Tracking.Hearing.Adjourn).
Marks ongoing hearing as Completed with judicial outcome recorded (FR-4.7.3 Tracking.Hearing.Complete).

get.description: Returns courtrooms and capacity for judicial resource allocation.

schema.title: Response List Courtrooms Api V1 Hearings Courtrooms Available Get

post.description:
Automatically compiles and generates the daily cause list (FR-4.4.3 CauseList.Generate).
Sorts by courtroom and hearing timings.

get.description: List all generated or published daily cause lists (FR-4.4.3 CauseList.View).

schema.title: Response List Cause Lists Api V1 Cause Lists Get

get.description: Retrieves full cause list entry breakdown for a specific date.

put.description: Publishes the finalized cause list, making it visible to the public and litigants (FR-4.4.3 CauseList.Publish).

get.description: Downloads printable Daily Cause List in PDF format (FR-4.4.3 CauseList.Download).
Returns calendar events for interactive judicial calendar views with filtering (FR-4.4.3 Calendar.View, Calendar.Filter).

schema.title: Response Get Calendar Events Api V1 Cause Lists Calendar Events Get

get.summary: Export iCalendar (.ics) Feed for Google / Outlook Sync
get.description: Exports calendar sync feed in RFC 5545 iCalendar standard format for Google Calendar, Outlook, and Apple Calendar (FR-4.4.3 Calendar.Sync).

post.description: Creates a secure virtual hearing link and session room (FR-4.6.3 VirtualHearing.Link.Generate).
Role-gated join access. Verifies authorization and tracks attendance (FR-4.6.3 VirtualHearing.Join & VirtualHearing.Attendance.Track).
Records departure timestamp in attendance tracking log.
Judge commences proceeding. Sets start time and updates hearing status to 'In Progress'.
Authorized recording controls for judge (FR-4.6.3 VirtualHearing.Record).
Concludes virtual hearing session, updates status, and triggers automated AI transcript generation (FR-4.6.3 VirtualHearing.End).

get.description: Retrieves complete attendance roster for the proceeding (FR-4.6.3 VirtualHearing.Attendance.Track).

schema.title: Response Get Attendees Api V1 Virtual Court Sessions  Online Hearing Id  Attendees Get

get.description: Retrieves the verbatim AI transcript (FR-4.6.3 VirtualHearing.Transcript.Generate).
Exports and downloads authenticated transcript PDF (Transcript.download()).
Public judicial display board showing currently proceeding matters across all courtrooms (SRS Section 4.7).

schema.title: Response Get Live Display Boards Api V1 Tracking Courtrooms Display Board Get

get.description: Returns live display board for a specific courtroom entrance screen.

put.description: Marks hearing as 'In Progress' and broadcasts live update across WebSockets (FR-4.7.3 Tracking.Hearing.Start).
Postpones a scheduled hearing and records reason (FR-4.7.3 Tracking.Hearing.Postpone).

get.description: Returns full chronological visual timeline of milestones from registration to disposal (FR-4.7.3 Tracking.Timeline).
Returns notification history for the authenticated user (FR-4.8.3 Notification.History).

schema.title: Response Get User Notifications Api V1 Notifications Get

put.description: Marks a single notification as read.
Clears unread badge count by marking all user's notifications as read.

post.description: Court staff manually dispatches an official alert to a specific judicial participant.
Invokes automated background reminder scan for scheduled hearings (FR-4.8.3 Notification.Hearing.Reminder).
Retries undelivered or failed email/SMS alerts according to retry policy (FR-4.8.3 Notification.Retry).

get.description: Returns operational notification metrics for judicial administrators.
Returns role-tailored dashboard metrics and summaries corresponding to SRS Section 3.1.

schema.title: Response Get Dashboard Overview Api V1 Dashboard Overview Get

get.description: View immutable judicial audit trails. Strictly restricted to Administrators (SRS NFR-5.3.7 & NFR-5.3.8).

schema.title: Response List Audit Logs Api V1 Audit Logs Get
